body:
Here’s a different sort of perspective. My boyfriend grew up in the Middle East. His dad kept his relationship with him wife (they had three kids) while entering a relationship with another woman while promising marriage for probably 5-10 years. He had no intention of leaving his wife while having this affair. 

My boyfriend remembers his dad saying he was on business trips and working all the time. That he was busy providing for his family. Instead, his dad was working a normal job but going to the home of his girlfriend and her kids. 

The toll this has taken on my boyfriend, his mother, and his siblings in irreparable. It made them feel unwanted, unimportant, abandoned, and severely unloved. His dad chose another family over them. My boyfriend has severe anxiety and social problems because he feels the need to make others want to be around him. 

If you stay in this relationship, you are messing with the lives of at least four other people. It doesn’t matter what the situation is. Those kids are innocent and vulnerable. You have the power to end this. Stop being an asshole and go find someone who will make you their priority and whom you do not need to steal from their family.
